title: Variance from distances to the two constants
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance is four times the product of its relative Hamming distances to the constant functions $+1$ and $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
